exact_holds.issue: §1.4 says Normative References None, while §5.7 states normative data model at B.2 and Appendix B.1 names DSDM; original DSDM/IDL and B.2 OpenAPI not inspected. Preserve exact source discrepancy and edition.

Rule requires shall, Recommendation should, Permission may, Observation no requirement, unlabeled prose descriptive. Do not elevate module descriptions or possible future capabilities as normative Profile shall.
Quality attributes and 15 source Architecture Principles are design drivers and broader objectives, not individually verified runtime behavior or universal information fields.

Sensor, external host, optional sensor pod, physical hardware, logical module, software runtime, interaction infrastructure, procurable unit are different referents; no universal chassis/class tree or ISA exact equivalence.
Tables include reserved modules, incomplete edition-dependent functionality, Future EO/IR & Comms flow work; not all modules are instantiated or defined or usable by current hardware.
Airworthiness/qualification discussion addresses aircraft mission/flight equipment; no universal requirement for all host environments and no proof of case equipment qualification.
Data-model DIV1/DIV2/DIV3 logical source roles and interconnect diagram inspected at text/label depth, but original C239 DSDM/IDL/native OpenAPI and exact figure pixel/edge geometry not verified.
